$comment: Every entry was checked against its source on verifiedAt. Before proposing an install, open `source` and read the current instructions there; `install` is a snapshot, not the authority. Entries older than 90 days are re-checked before use. `signals` drive recommendations in round 7; `overlapsWith` drives the stacking warning. verifiedAt null means the entry describes the tool but the install command was not checked; read the source first. `auth` gives the login and status commands the skill walks the user through (status is run by the user or with their ok, never by the probes). `replacesMcp` lists MCP server names (matched case-insensitively as substrings) that this CLI can replace.
